#let pub-entry(img-path, title, authors, venue, summary: none, url: none) = {
  block(
    width: 100%,
    stroke: (bottom: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb")),
    inset: (y: 10pt),
  )[
    #grid(
      columns: (100pt, 1fr),
      gutter: 14pt,
      box(
        clip: true,
        stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb"),
        image(img-path, width: 100pt),
      ),
      [
        #text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#2563eb"), font: "Liberation Mono", weight: "medium")[#upper(venue)]
        #if url != none {
          h(6pt)
          link(url, text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#2563eb"), font: "Liberation Mono", weight: "medium")[\[pdf\]])
        }
        \
        #v(2pt)
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#111827"), size: 10pt)[#title]\
        #v(2pt)
        #text(fill: rgb("#6b7280"), size: 9pt)[#authors]
        #if summary != none {
          v(3pt)
          text(fill: rgb("#9ca3af"), size: 8pt, style: "italic")[#summary]
        }
      ],
    )
  ]
}

## Reviewing

I have served as a reviewer for the following venues:

- International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026
- Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2025
- IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS) 2025
- IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2025
